mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT m_stores.store_id, m_stores.store_name FROM m_books INNER JOIN store_books ON m_books.book_id = store_books.book_id INNER JOIN m_stores ON store_books.store_id = m_stores.store_id LEFT JOIN t_inventories ON m_books.book_id = t_inventories.book_id WHERE t_inventories.book_id IS NULL;
